response.overview: In 1994, Eros Poli defied all odds to ascend legendary Mont Ventoux to a solo breakaway victory on a brutally hot day in the 15th stage of the Tour de France.  In GRINTA!, we revisit the mountain with Eros thirty years later. Hearing him tell the story of his iconic win, exploring the path that got him there, and opening up a conversation around what’s still possible for everyone in midlife.GRINTA! Is a love story to cycling, the Tour de France, Eros himself, and what it means to have the grit and determination to not just persevere, but to endure.
response.title: GRINTA!
